rows.en: ＊Narusawa＊＠００２＿００８Looks like you fell just short.￥...Too bad.
＊Sakaki＊＠００２＿００９Don't let it get you down. You￥still have an important job:￥supporting those who qualified.
＊Narusawa＊＠００２＿０１０Starting tomorrow, we'll be busy￥getting those who qualified￥ready to leave.
＊Sakaki＊＠００２＿０１１We'll need all of you to￥help out. We're counting on you.
